Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Crime Police kill suspected serial rapist and robber linked to seven cases in Kade Source : Myjoyonline.com 24 November 2026 6:58pm ▶ Listen to this article Audio By Carbonatix
The Eastern South Regional Police Command says a 39-year-old ex-convict suspected of carrying out a series of rape and robbery attacks in the Kade area of the Eastern Region has died after sustaining gunshot wounds during a police operation.
The suspect, identified as Kwaku Asomani, was also linked to the murder of a 28-year-old woman, Esther Opoku, whose body was found on October 1, 2026, opposite Hotel De Nyarko in the Guggisberg area of Kade.
In a press release dated November 24, the Police said preliminary investigations had linked Asomani to seven incidents of robbery and rape involving female victims between February 19 and November 10, 2026.
The victims, aged between 18 and 54, were allegedly robbed of various sums of money and personal belongings before being sexually assaulted.
The Police said a team of investigators from the Anti-Armed Robbery Unit of the Criminal Investigations Department (CID) Headquarters, working with personnel from the Kade District Police Command, located the suspect on November 14 at Assemblies of God in Kade.
The operation followed what the Command described as intensive surveillance.
Asomani reportedly sustained gunshot wounds during the operation and died as a result.
A search of his person and residence led to the retrieval of a face cap and other clothing items, which the Police said had been identified by some of the victims.
The Eastern South Regional Police Command has extended its condolences to the family of Esther Opoku and said it is making arrangements to provide psychosocial support to the surviving victims.
The Command also reaffirmed the Ghana Police Service's commitment to combating violent crime and ensuring public safety.
